title: Twitch Roobert / Custom typeface
slide_intent: Show a typeface in both a large specimen and meaningful language so its voice can be judged beyond an isolated name.
strategic_value: Pairing Roobert with the Konami Code can connect Twitch’s custom typography to its gaming culture.
demonstration: A purple specimen labels Twitch Roobert Semibold at 750pt and 200pt, pairs its name with the Konami Code, and lists weight and italic options.
practical_value: Compare the large letterforms with a longer phrase; treat the printed point sizes as specimen labels rather than universal text roles.

content_islands.name: Typeface name
content_islands.spec: Place the oversized black Roobert name under the 750pt specimen label.

content_islands.name: Code specimen
content_islands.spec: Set the Konami Code across multiple lines beneath the 200pt label, using arrows between commands.

content_islands.name: Weight list
content_islands.spec: List Heavy through Light with corresponding italic variants in a ruled footer.

reference_purposes.Expression: The custom face is demonstrated through its name and gaming-language specimen.
reference_purposes.Application: The board labels two specimen sizes and lists the available weight/italic range.

ingredient.name: Twitch Roobert
ingredient.role: Give brand language a consistent typographic voice.
ingredient.application: Compare Semibold in a large name and multiline command sequence; use the listed family range when evaluating hierarchy.
ingredient.scope: The 750pt and 200pt labels describe this specimen, not required sizes for every Twitch application. The footer lists family weights and italic variants; no application scale is prescribed.
